name: Greater Tokyo
author: MasterPapple
description:
The Kantō plain across Saitama, Chiba, Tōkyō and Kanagawa — 18.4 million modelled residents over 16,622 km², from 11,283 census-level demand points.

Commute flows come from a **doubly-constrained gravity model** calibrated against Japan's 2020 Census municipality containment statistics, so employment as well as residence totals are reproduced: every central ward receives job arrivals within 0.97–1.04× its real count, and the routed mean commute of 14.4 km matches Tokyo's measured 14.7 km.
